Messages.Author: Pandemic
Messages.Body:
> Myrdin wrote:
> Is it only me or do Giovanni decks dominate in Italy? (no pun intended)
>
Well, no, not really. Two of the best italian players have a Giovanni deck in their range of preferred deck, this one for Alessandro Donati and a Shambling deck from Danilo Torrisi. That said, in Italy there is a wide range of decks. If I have to tell a tendency it's that wall decks are fewer than in the international environment.
